summary: Form field that holds violet-radio children and submits the one selected value.

usage.text: Set the group's value attribute to a radio's value to select it; with no group value, a radio marked checked is used. The group overwrites each radio's checked state, tabindex and, when the group has a name, its name.

A click delivers two change events to a listener on the group: the group's own (detail.value) and the clicked radio's bubbling one (detail.checked). Keyboard selection delivers only the group's. Check event.target.
The group is one tab stop. Arrow keys, Home and End move focus and select in the same step.

a11y.text: An aria-label on the host takes precedence over the label attribute as the group's name; the label stays visible.
